menu_options.credentials: Email, password and CapSolver API key

credentials.title: MyPolaris.ro
credentials.description: Use this mode if you want the integration to log in automatically on each refresh. It requires your MyPolaris password and a CapSolver API key.

session_cookie.title: MyPolaris.ro
session_cookie.description: Recommended: log in at https://my.polaris.ro in a browser, open DevTools → Application → Cookies, copy the value of ASP.NET_SessionId, and paste it below. Email is still required for the unique ID and entity naming.

error.invalid_api_key: API key must start with 'CAI-' and be at least 30 characters long.

init.title: MyPolaris - Settings
init.description: If the MyPolaris session expires, paste a fresh ASP.NET_SessionId cookie here and save. You can keep the existing values for any fields you do not want to change.
